revisions.description: Added the hpicfGenRptrSwitchConfigGroup. Added NOTIFICATION-GROUP information.
Split this MIB module from the former monolithic hp-icf MIB. Added the hpicfGenRptrInfoGroup, the hpicfGenRptrBkpLinkGroup, and the hpicfGenRptrPortMappingGroup.
Version of MIB module that added support for the HPJ2413A and HPJ2415A 100VG hubs, and the HPJ2414B agent module. Added the hpicfGenRptrSecPtGroup.
Version of MIB module that added support for the HPJ2410A 100VG repeater and the HPJ2414A agent module. Added the hpicfGenRptrBasicGroup.
Initial version of this MIB module. Released with the HPJ2355A hub.
